report.summary: PLAY12 scoped city-label package on adopted base 0178350. Added four compact helpers immediately before drawCity (cityCssWidth, drawCityActiveLabel, drawCityPlayerBadge, cityLabelBadge) and replaced only the two authorized spans inside drawCity: the three passive place-label lines are now wrapped in an active branch (original statements preserved verbatim in the fallback branch, also used when an active anchor is off screen), and the bare '你' text call now uses the player badge helper. Badges render in world units inside the unchanged camera matrix, size from the canvas getBoundingClientRect CSS width (logical-1100 fallback for missing/zero/non-DOM recorders; non-metric measureText also tolerated), guarantee >=11 CSS px effective font while never shrinking the original 16 world-unit base, keep full untruncated names, stay within the logical canvas with >=4 CSS px margins via minimal edge shifts, and never pull an offscreen marker onto the screen; coincident current/active badges separate to opposite sides (market above-anchor stacks deterministically over the player badge). No camera/core/UI/geometry/icon/route changes; active definition unchanged (view.target===place.id || mode place/view.place). Baseline RED captured against the untouched scene: 10/12 new tests failed on missing behavior (effective fonts ~3/8 CSS px, no opaque player badge, no active enhancement at narrow widths); reduced-motion determinism and input immutability already passed. After implementation and one targeted correction (measureText guard for the retained old-harness pass-through recorder) the candidate is GREEN 12/12, and the retained suites pass unchanged (13 city + 8 street-atmosphere assertions); both files pass node --check.

tests.summary: candidate GREEN: 12/12 tests pass (readability/bounds grid at CSS 320/350/360/368/390/1100 x street/overview z1/z2 x DPR 1/1.5; seven names with exactly one enhanced active label and six byte-style-identical passive labels; no implicit target; coincident pub and market badge separation; offscreen anchor never faked; edge clamps keep real icon anchors; missing/zero getBoundingClientRect logical fallback; DPR-independent effective CSS; reduced-motion determinism; view/geometry immutability; night parity).
all retained old assertions pass: 13/13 city tests and 8/8 street-atmosphere tests, including full-frame reduced-motion equality, finite geometry, balanced save/restore and cityTransform inversion.
